scope: Paired spin and projector sensitivity for the two retained seed-0 leader endpoints; stages follow their scientific dependencies.
limitations: Cost model excludes projection and does not calibrate alternate spin iteration counts; do not scale all variants from one successful atomic pair.
Same inherited U across projectors tests projector dependence; it does not calibrate transferable U or choose a physically correct projector by lower total energy.
Four starts are a bounded basin search, not proof of a magnetic ground state.
All endpoints are fixed and unrelaxed; this is not a candidate ranking or pathway/free-energy test.
readout: Require approved input/UPF bytes, terminal converged finite SCF and force table, complete atom-resolved Lowdin moments and occupation records.
For each projector and spin variant compute E(pull2.10)-E(builder) only if both endpoints are valid. Preserve failed or missing attempts.

Within each projector report all state energies relative to its own endpoint minimum, local moment texture and the branch gap using each endpoint minimum over the four sampled starts. Never compare absolute totals between projector Hamiltonians to pick a winner.
Compare paired branch gaps between projectors, naming any simultaneous electronic-basin differences. No new statistical or accuracy threshold.

next_stages.name: Numerical sensitivity
next_stages.work: Paired SCF tolerance/cutoff/smearing/k-mesh tests on the identified branch, with nk4 baseline control for k6x3 and joint tighter-setting confirmation; inspect basin continuity.

next_stages.name: DFT endpoint relaxation
next_stages.work: Relax both endpoints at fixed cell and original slab constraints; require final SCF, force and ionic convergence plus chemical connectivity audit. Retain distinct basins/failures; no silent retries.

next_stages.name: Winning chain and independent panel
next_stages.work: Evaluate actual seed-1 winning chain and frozen discovery/held-out chains, preserving partition and any unconverged MACE geometries. Update shortlist only after comparable full chains.

baseline_reference.reuse_policy: Run one location only. Prefer a terminal converged original with matching deck hash, JOB DONE, force table and local-moment/occupation records; otherwise select one location before submission. A terminal failed original remains a failed attempt, not permission for a silent companion retry. If companion ran first, reuse it and omit the original equivalent. Preserve actual output paths/hashes; never copy outputs under a new prefix.

limitations: HEA spin texture/ntyp overhead and tighter-SCF iteration count are uncalibrated
3x figures are monitoring thresholds/scenarios, not enforced caps or statistical bounds
projwfc.x overhead is excluded; smoke measurements must replace model assumptions
cost.method: hea_cost_model model A with explicit max(Ewfc/80,Erho/640)**1.5 cutoff scaling
